item.title: Notes and Obsidian
item.description:
Open Notes from the app rail or press Ctrl+Shift+N. On macOS, press Cmd+Shift+N. Notes fills the full window width. Choose Terminal in the Notes header to return to the terminal. Pressing Esc does not close Notes; Esc can still dismiss a Notes dialog or menu.

The source tabs run across the top of Notes. Choose Local notes or an enabled Obsidian vault to switch sources. Each source remembers its own open folder, note, filters, and view. The left sidebar stacks folders above the file list; drag its divider to resize it, or focus the divider and press the arrow keys. The sidebar width is remembered when you leave Notes.
